question.text: Digit at the unit place of the sum of <math><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>!</mo></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>!</mo></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>!</mo></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup><mo>…</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>…</mo><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2008</mn><mo>!</mo></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></math> is

solution.text:
Given the sum S= ( 1! ) 2 + ( 2! ) 2 + ( 3! ) 2 +.......+ ( 2008! ) 2

Since the digit at units place is zero in n! for n≥5

Hence,  S= ( 1 ) 2 + ( 2 ) 2 + ( 6 ) 2 + ( 24 ) 2 + numbers having zero at units place

=617+ all other numbers having zero at units place
